answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 14 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 620 identities costs 620 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. The vine of the design is public, the zenith of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the sonnet of honest work is what finally pays.
